reference_sql:
SELECT order_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY order_month
alternatives: SELECT order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, ROUND(CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS units_per_order, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN units ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_month

SELECT order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(units, 0)) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS units_per_order, ROUND(100 * CAST(SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS DOUBLE) / SUM(units), 1) AS web_units_pct FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
